name: std::multimap<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::end, std::multimap<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::cend
intro:
Returns an iterator to the element following the last element of the multimap.

This element acts as a placeholder; attempting to access it results in undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Iterator to the element following the last element.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: libc++ backports cend() to C++98 mode.

summary: Returns an iterator to the element following the last element of the multimap.
